data.gender_notes: Dorotheon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dorothea is a name meaning 'gift of God'. In Christianity, Dorotheon is a name given to early saints and martyrs, representing the gift of faith and divine grace. The name Dorotheon carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dorotheon usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual gift of faith and the grace bestowed by God.
data.etymology: Dorotheon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dorotheon total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: דורוטיון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דורוטיון הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מתנה של אלוהים'. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'דורוס' (מתנה) ו'תאוס' (אלוהים). השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים ובמסורת הכנסייתית.

in_greek.name: Δοροθέον
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Δοροθέον είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'δώρο του Θεού'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος προκύπτει από τις λέξεις 'δωρον' (δώρο) και 'θεος' (Θεός). Το όνομα αυτό έχει ιστορικά χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία και στη χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Dorotheon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorotheon origine Graeco, significationem habet 'donum Dei' seu 'munus divinum'. Compositum est ex vocibus 'doros' (donum) et 'theos' (Deus). In traditione christiana et ecclesiastica nomen hoc usitatum est.

in_english.name: Dorotheon
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorotheon originates from Greek roots, specifically from the words 'doron' (gift) and 'theos' (God), signifying 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. Historically, the name has been used within Christian tradition, symbolizing a child as a precious gift from God. It carries spiritual significance, reflecting the belief in God's providence and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: Dorotheon, as a Christian name, carries the cultural significance of being derived from the Greek name Dorothea, which signifies a gift from God. This name was popular among early saints and martyrs in the Christian faith, and holds a rich history within spiritual communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Dorotheon, as a name, highlights the importance of faith and divine grace in a person's life. It is a reminder of the ultimate gift that God has bestowed upon humanity - the gift of faith and salvation. This spiritual significance has made Dorotheon a beloved and inspiring name within the Christian community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dorotheon: Greek origin meaning 'gift of God', symbolizing the belief that every human life is a divine gift, and a reminder of our inherent worth and value in the eyes of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dorotheon is mentioned in the Codex Sinaiticus The name Dorotheon carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Dorotheon is mentioned in the Codex Sinaiticus as a variant of the name Dorotheus

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dorotheon remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Thomas Dorotheon, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Dorotheon meaning "Gift of God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
